subject: Sheridan Health — quick recap and fit check
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Sheridan <alex.sheridan@sheridanhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sheridan Health — quick recap and fit check

Alex — thanks again for taking time today. Quick post-call recap and a couple quick asks so we can decide next steps: 

Recap (30-min call):
- Primary use case: triage and automated routing of patient messages into care teams, reducing manual triage time.
- Key constraints: PHI scope limited to metadata only for now; latency target ~350ms p50 for short chat flows.
- Success criteria: 30% reduction in triage latency, maintain >95% QA pass rate on routing decisions.

Fit questions for you:
1) Does the use case and success criteria reflect what your team needs?
2) Are there any blockers on the data side (access to sample messages, retention constraints)?

Proposed next steps:
- If fit looks promising: 15–20 minute technical follow to map sample traffic and discuss model/policy constraints.
- If not: quick note on why and any alternative priorities.

I can make time next week (Wed/Thu morning PST) — what works best? I attached a one-pager and a draft mutual action plan to make it easier for procurement to see the path.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: Sheridan-Redwood-onepager.pdf (one-pager), MAP-Sheridan-202611.pdf (draft mutual action plan)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Sheridan <alex.sheridan@sheridanhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@sheridanhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Sheridan Health — one-pager and suggested next steps (MAP included)

Alex / Procurement team — looping procurement since price/term clarity will speed any pilot decision. I know inboxes get busy so wanted to surface a concise path forward: 

What I attached: 
- Sheridan-Redwood-onepager.pdf: short value/arch summary tailored to triage use case.
- MAP-Sheridan-202611.pdf: suggested milestones, owners, and timeline for a 6-week pilot.
- redwood-pricing-bands-2026.xlsx: high-level pricing bands; final quote will depend on committed throughput and retention settings.

Suggested pilot MAP (high level):
1) Week 0–1: access + sample exchange (anonymized/metadata), success criteria sign-off.
2) Week 2–3: small-scale pilot (10k messages/day) — validate routing accuracy + latency.
3) Week 4–6: scale and handoff to ops, finalize SLA and billing.

If this looks reasonable I can put Laura on a quick call to walk procurement through pricing bands and commit options. Would a 15–30 minute slot next Tue (24th) or Wed (25th) morning PST work for procurement?

Thanks — happy to tailor the MAP if you prefer different milestones.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Sheridan-Redwood-onepager.pdf, MAP-Sheridan-202611.pdf, redwood-pricing-bands-2026.xlsx

From: Alex Sheridan <alex.sheridan@sheridanhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@sheridanhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sheridan Health — one-pager and suggested next steps (MAP included)

Karthik — sorry for the delay, been heads down with an EMR migration. The one-pager and MAP look reasonable and we like the proposed pilot cadence. Two quick items from our side: 

- Procurement will need a clearer per-message / per-token estimate and any data residency notes for the pilot.
- Clinical team wants to see a short sample of model outputs on an anonymized batch (500 messages) before we kick off.

Can we book 30 minutes on Tue 24th at 10:00am PST to walk procurement and clinical through pricing and the sample plan? Laura — can you join that call to cover pricing bands?

Appreciate the follow-up — Alex
Alex Sheridan
Director, Digital Ops | Sheridan Health
alex.sheridan@sheridanhealth.com
